description:
§7.6 rule (b) (S483 q8-fu) — `${ const c: string = s.repeat(600000000); }` inside `

5)>`: a literal repeat count whose result is not proven to fit the longest string can trap (E-INDEX-OUT-OF-RANGE-RT) and the initializer runs before the test — E-FILE-SCOPE-INIT-IN-CONSTRUCT.
rationale: §7.6 rule (b) (S483): "An initializer there that can trap SHALL be E-FILE-SCOPE-INIT-IN-CONSTRUCT"; a literal `repeat` count or pad width is a trap site unless the result's length is provably within the limit (S483 q8-fu, #2129 r1 review MED-1 — before, every literal was exempt and the page blanked). ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-trapping-construct-init — owner: "yes, interim refusal now and the feature later".
